name: FOODIO
tagline: Food ordering platform with quick delivery and secure payments.
problem: Food delivery platforms often lack intuitive interfaces and real-time tracking.
solution: Developed a seamless food ordering experience with real-time order tracking and secure payment integration.
metaDesc: Food ordering platform with real-time tracking and secure payments.
architecture: Built on the MERN stack with a responsive React frontend, Express.js backend API, and MongoDB for data persistence. Real-time order tracking is powered by Socket.io for live updates between customers and the restaurant backend.
